title: Pet Care Printable Bundle | Puppy Training Plan, Pet Health Record, New Pet Checklist, Dog Grooming, Cat Enrichment PDF | Instant Download
description:
All five Mavilo Pet Co. guides in one purchase. Everything you need to train, care for and track your pet, and you save 16 dollars compared with buying them separately.

Whether you just brought home a puppy, adopted a cat, or share your home with both, this bundle gives you a complete, printable toolkit for the first days and the years that follow.

WHAT'S INSIDE (5 PDFs, 70 pages total, US Letter)
1. The 30-Day Puppy Training Plan (19 pages, sold separately for 14 dollars): week-by-week positive-reinforcement plan, potty and crate schedules, socialization checklist, the 30-day daily plan table, progress tracker.
2. New Pet Starter Checklist Kit for Dogs and Cats (12 pages, 7 dollars): shopping and pet-proofing checklists, first day / week / month plan, budget planner, emergency contacts.
3. Pet Health and Care Record Book (14 pages, 9 dollars): vaccination, vet visit, medication, weight, parasite prevention and grooming logs, emergency info cards.
4. At-Home Dog Grooming Guide (13 pages, 12 dollars): brushing, bathing, nails, ears, teeth, stress-free handling, schedule by coat type, monthly checklist.
5. Indoor Cat Enrichment and Play Guide (12 pages, 9 dollars): 30 DIY enrichment ideas, play styles, food puzzles, 4-week calendar, play log.

Total value 51 dollars, yours for 35.

WHO IT'S FOR
- New pet parents who want everything organized from day one
- Households with both dogs and cats
- Anyone looking for a thoughtful, instantly delivered gift for a new pet owner

HOW IT WORKS
1. Buy - nothing is shipped, no waiting.
2. Download instantly - all five PDFs are available under Purchases & Reviews right after payment, and Etsy emails you a download link.
3. Print at home on US Letter (8.5 x 11 in), or fill it in on a tablet with any PDF annotation app.

MADE WITH CARE
Mavilo Pet Co. is a small pet-loving shop. Every guide begins with our own outline, structure and design. We use generative AI tools to help draft text and layouts; a person then edits, fact-checks and approves every page before it is sold, so what you download reflects our original direction and human review.

These guides are educational and is not veterinary advice. Always consult your veterinarian or a certified trainer about your own pet.

License: personal, non-commercial use in your own household. Please do not resell or share the file. Digital downloads are non-refundable once delivered, but if anything is wrong with your file, message us and we will fix it.
